messages:
incident-bot: PAGE — High error rate and queue growth for /v2/generate in us-west-2. 11 tenants impacted, errors ~15% of requests, page routed to SRE Oncall.
Alex R: ACKed. I'm oncall for the window, jumping in. Any immediate mitigation?
Priya S: seeing steady 504/502 spikes from the runtime and long spike in tail latency. Queue depth on the router has grown to ~1.8k requests.
Marco L: quick metrics dump: GPU pool (redwood-gpu-usw2) shows 3 active pods out of target 8; autoscaler HPA target 8, current replicas 3, desired 8 but HPA not increasing. VM provisioning events show several pods in ContainerCreating for >4m.
Priya S: affected models primarily quantized-medium and medium; small models OK. TTL on warmup cache increased miss rate.
Alex R: hypothesis tracker in-thread: H1: HPA controller lag / kube-controller stuck, not issuing scale due to stale metrics. H2: node warmup/timeslice — instance boot/attach delay causing pods in Pending. H3: GPU driver/kernel OOM/warmup causing pods to fail readiness and not count toward capacity. H4: sudden burst of longer sequences causing KV cache pressure and slow per-token.
Marco L: collecting logs now. Sharing HPA status and pod describe:
```
$ kubectl -n inference get hpa redwood-runtime
NAME             REFERENCE                        TARGETS   MINPODS   MAXPODS   REPLICAS   AGE
redwood-runtime  Deployment/redwood-runtime      80%/100%   3         8         3          12m

$ kubectl -n inference describe hpa redwood-runtime
Events:
  12m   Normal  Synced  New size: 8
  11m   Warning  FailedGetScale  rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded
```
Marco L: pod describe snippets: several pods stuck at ContainerCreating with message "Attaching volume /nvme/gpu-cache: timeout attaching block device".
Priya S: Datadog shows kube-apiserver latency spikes around the same time, and cloud provider attach calls returning 504s.
datadog-bot: Dashboard link https://datadog.example.net/dash/abcd/runtime-queue?from=now-30m&to=now
Alex R: immediate mitigation: Priya, can you spin a manual scale to get more ready pods while we investigate HPA? If attach ops are failing, manual pods might hit same problem but worth trying small incremental scale.
Priya S: scaling to 6 now: `kubectl -n inference scale deploy/redwood-runtime --replicas=6`
Priya S: after scale: 6 pods scheduled, but 2 still ContainerCreating, 4 Ready. Queue depth drops from 1800 -> 900 after new ready pods drain some requests. Latency improves but still taily.
Alex R: good. Marco, capture kubelet logs for nodes with ContainerCreating. Also get cloud provider attach trace IDs.
Marco L: grabbing kubelet + cloud provider logs. Snapshot from provider API shows ephemeral volume attach retries and a spike of attach latency ~s 45-60s.
Marco L: also found several pods with imagePullBackOff earlier, likely unrelated but worth noting for timeline.
Alex R: updating hypothesis: core issue seems to be cloud block attach delay causing pods to remain unready -> effective GPU pool capacity lower -> queue grows -> increased tail latency. Still need to confirm why attach latency spiked.
Priya S: customer impact note: 11 tenants saw >=25% error rate for 10-22 minutes; some saw soft failures (timeouts) and some long-lived 5xx. Internally escalate to support for affected tenants.
Marco L: timeline draft: 00:00 - normal; 00:03 - sudden traffic increase ~2.5x for medium models; 00:04 - cloud attach latency increases, several attach retries; 00:05 - HPA desired set to 8 but scale RPC hits DeadlineExceeded; 00:06 - new pods in Pending/ContainerCreating; 00:10 - manual scale to 6 results in 4 ready pods; 00:20 - queue drained and error rate returns to baseline.
Alex R: open action items in-thread: A1 collect full attach RPC logs and correlate with cloud provider status during spike (Marco). A2 run control-plane metrics snapshot for HPA controller + api-server latencies (Priya). A3 run a repro for warmup/cache misses (SRE Oncall). A4 customer impact note and notify accounts team (Alex R).
SRE Oncall: taking A3. I'll run a load-repro in staging to see if cache eviction + attach delay triggers same behavior.
Marco L: evidence so far: attach retries + provider-side throttling in logs, HPA controller logged FailedGetScale RPC errors. Likely root: provider attach throttling + HPA control plane retries -> delayed scale -> pool saturation.
Alex R: remediation (short-term): add a safety buffer of reserved warm standby nodes in Dedicated pools to cover attach spikes; add HPA controller retry/backoff tuning; investigate switching to local NVMe-backed ephemeral for faster warmup.
Priya S: follow-ups: 1) Add alert for HPA rpc errors >3 in 5m, 2) add metric for ContainerCreating > X minutes per pool, 3) postmortem with timeline + evidence + customer impact.
Marco L: I'll attach logs and CloudTrace IDs to the incident doc.
Alex R: handoff — Marco takes next 30m for deep-dive; Priya will create the customer-facing impact note. I'll start the RCA skeleton in drive: https://drive.redwood/team/incidents/1786012345-rca (creating sections: timeline, evidence, hypotheses, mitigations, follow-ups).
Priya S: customer note draft: "We experienced elevated error rates for /v2/generate in us-west-2 between 00:04–00:24 UTC due to delayed GPU provisioning/backing storage attach, leading to temporary capacity shortfall. We’ve taken steps to mitigate and are working on long-term fixes."
SRE Oncall: leaving this thread, will watch the doc and results of staging repro.
Alex R: thanks all. Closing on-call active mitigation. We'll reconvene in the RCA doc and create action tickets for the follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
